title: Hosted API protobuf decode edge-case causing amplified retries — targeted patch & tenant quarantine
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Several enterprise customers reported intermittent 5xx responses and timeouts during high-concurrency uploads. Investigation shows a protobuf decoding edge-case on a specific model payload path that causes the request handler to throw, which current SDK/edge retry logic treats as retriable. Retries amplify load and trigger KV cache churn and backend request storms for affected tenants. This ticket scopes a targeted fix: (1) hardening decode path with schema validation + graceful non-retriable error, (2) add per-tenant inflight caps and soft quarantine to stop amplification, (3) add observability and runbook entries for faster triage.
acceptance_criteria: 1) Protobuf decode returns 4xx-style structured error for malformed payloads instead of transient 5xx. 2) SDK/edge mapping: handler marks these errors as non-retriable so client retries are not triggered. 3) Per-tenant inflight cap prevents >N concurrent map-reduce model requests and triggers soft quarantine when threshold exceeded. 4) New Grafana dashboard panels surface protobuf decode errors, retry spikes, and tenant quarantine events. 5) Runbook added and validated with a simulated tenant surge in staging.
implementation_notes:
- Add strict proto schema check at request ingress; fall back to canonical error message with error_code=PROTO_DECODE_INVALID and HTTP 400.
- Update internal error classification table: PROTO_DECODE_INVALID -> non-retriable.
- Introduce tenant_inflight_limit configurable via tenant config (default 300 concurrent tokens). When exceeded mark tenant state = SOFT_QUARANTINE and return HTTP 429 with Retry-After to callers.
- Backfill telemetry: count_protobuf_decode_errors, tenant_inflight_counter, tenant_quarantine_events, retry_amplification_ratio.
- Safe rollout: cold-start patch behind feature flag runtime.proto_hardening_v1; progressively enable for affected tenants then global.
- Performance: micro-benchmark protobuf path; ensure <1% p99 additional CPU overhead on ingress path.
- Add e2e test: malformed proto -> HTTP 400 and no backend request emitted.
technical_tradeoffs:
- Returning 400 for malformed payloads risks surface area change for some custom SDKs that expect 5xx; mitigated by clear changelog and SDK patch.
- Per-tenant inflight cap could increase client-side latency under heavy load; chosen soft quarantine returns 429 with Retry-After to avoid silent failures.
- Feature flag rollout chosen to expedite mitigation for impacted customers while preserving testability.
work_items: Add proto schema validator and canonical error path (ingress handler)
Update error classification and retry policy mapping
Implement tenant inflight limiter and soft quarantine state
Create Grafana panels and alerts for proto_decode_error rate and retry_amplification_ratio
Write runbook + incident playbook entries and test in staging
Publish SDK advisory and update retry guidance

2025-02-16 — QA (Noah Kim): E2E tests added and passing in staging. Regression test included: streaming and non-streaming routes validated. Noted one flaky test related to connection reuse — tracked in ENG-314160.
